_note: The prop facing pass (world/prop_facing.rs), run once when a level-0 chunk is built, after the Godot-ported generator and its golden-checked output (docs/PROP_FACING.md). North is the map's -z (cell y - 1): rotation 0. A solid floor prop beside a wall turns its back to the wall and faces the longest open run; a prop of a dressing set with no wall beside it faces north. Type lists match a prop type when the lower-case type contains the entry. keep_types are never touched (beds, lockers, hiding props, doors, plumbing, anything whose use reads its facing). symmetric_types have no front, so they are never re-faced but may still take a diagonal. run_cap is how many cells an open run is counted to. wall_gap is how far a deep prop's back stays off the wall face (Godot's 5 cm: the centre moves out by half depth - (0.5 - wall_gap) when that is positive). diagonal: free_types standing clear of every wall, outside furnished-room templates, turn 45 degrees on a hashed share free_chance; corner_types in a corner (walls behind two sides) face diagonally out of it on corner_chance, moved out of the corner by at most max_corner_shift metres so the turned model stays out of the walls. never_types are never diagonal (seats: sitting reads quarter turns). A non-square collider becomes the bounding box of the turned box; a square or round one is kept.
